# Vendored dependencies

MicroQuickJS is vendored from <https://github.com/bellard/mquickjs>.

- Commit: `6d4d7eb6b99011d5aab6e88a9b99e8fd4d86c6e9`
- Source archive: `https://codeload.github.com/bellard/mquickjs/tar.gz/6d4d7eb6b99011d5aab6e88a9b99e8fd4d86c6e9`
- Archive SHA-256: `93e82d77bf62850023fc0e597827a62d6d0465225cd8731b04359a995187888b`

Generated headers and build products belong in Cargo's `OUT_DIR`, not in this
directory. No network download is performed by the worker build.
